pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: FRENCH
Strand: Writing 3. 2 Guided writing Extended • Handwriting • Word recognition • Clarity 
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Guided Writing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you know time is different at different moments of the day?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. write common words with correct orthography
2. create simple sentences using correct structures
3. appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts
4. identify meaning of words and expressions as used in written texts
5. write short narratives using vocabulary and grammar structures learned

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Guided Writing

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Guided Writing

Teach
• Focus skill: write common words with correct orthography.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Guided Writing.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Guided Writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you know time is different at different moments of the day?
2. What interesting things do you do as you travel?
3. Why is it important to follow rules and regulations while travelling?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
